explanation: The value peaks at GO: 10 when the agent chooses a1 and 8 (7-9) when it chooses a2. At D1 it is 5-8 if the previous trial was unrewarded (highest after two misses in a row, about 3-4 when a2 is the current choice) and 1-3 if rewarded, and at D2 it is 2-3 after choosing a1 (1-2 if S2 was reached) but 0 when a2 is the current choice.
